visual_blocks.heading: ORIGINAL MCQ MASTERY SET - EXACTLY 48 QUESTIONS
visual_blocks.preview: Questions 1-40 are core coverage - four per subtopic across the ten subtopics; Questions 41-48 are remedial items targeting the most common misreadings. Correct answers rotate strictly A -> B -> C -> D 12 times.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 1 - The Classification Problem: Who Rules, For Whom, Under What Limits
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Concept spine -> WHO / FOR WHOSE GOOD / BY WHAT TITLE / UNDER WHAT LIMITS -> descriptive or normative? -> only then expound the specific form.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 2 - Plato: The Degeneration of Constitutions and the Critique of Democracy
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 2025 = "Comment on Plato's critique of Democracy". Four moves, ~150 words: target -> spine -> objection -> graded verdict. Never a description dump.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 3 - Aristotle: The Six-Fold Matrix, Aristocracy/Oligarchy and the Polity
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Matrix = number x purpose (F2). Middle-course = polity + middle class (F3). "Common interest" is not self-specifying -- name the standard you use.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 4 - Monarchy: Absolute vs Constitutional, Freedom and the Above-Politics Claim
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Freedom stem -> constitutional-only "yes". Systematic stem -> "above party, not above the constitution". Never let symbolic monarchy blur into autocracy.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 5 - Theocracy: Divine Sovereignty, Secularism and the Validity Question
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Theocracy = 3 owned stems. Status (2019, residual) / relation to monarchy (2022, divine-right bridge) / validity (2025, criterion verdict). Never caricature.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 6 - Democracy: Models, Institutional Forms and Minority Protection
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 2018 = liberal democracy + social cohesion (Indian context, Ambedkar). 2020 = minority protection, degree judgment (form vs substance). Liberty/equality as distinctive features (2018 Q2a) is Ideals, not here.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 7 - Authority, Legitimacy and the Non-Democratic Forms (Weber, Schumpeter, Michels)
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Authority types = ground of belief (F4). Routinisation (F5) = succession/ systematic. Sequence: Plato (competence) -> Michels (organisation) -> Schumpeter (redefine). Never equate "legitimate" with "justified".

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 8 - Populism, Illiberal Democracy and Propaganda
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 2022 propaganda (20) = regulator's dilemma + structural remedies. 2023 challenges (15) = form-vs-substance + institutional repairs. Never name actors.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 9 - Institutional and Territorial Design: Federal/Unitary, Decentralisation and Inter-Form Debates
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Federal/unitary + decentralisation = SCAFFOLDING (not owned PYQs). Comparison rule: shared axes in parallel; error-correction is the axis that decides verdicts.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 10 - Mixed/Constitutional Government, Criteria of Evaluation and the Comparative Verdict
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Same axes in parallel -> error-correction decides -> graded verdict. No form wins on every axis; say which axis you are weighting and why.

visual_blocks.heading: Practice Design
visual_blocks.preview: DIRECTIVE -> THESIS -> DOCTRINE -> NAMED EVIDENCE / EXAMPLE -> OBJECTION / REPLY -> VERDICT
